gaps.title: When a chapter is left with no text, its title stops counting toward the book's word total, so deleting its last paragraph lowers the total by more than the words deleted.
Edits to DIFFERENT chapters on two devices are not merged: the writer must pick one copy; the other copy's chapter survives only inside a History snapshot.
A box set can only add later volumes as Word/Markdown/text files ("Add a Book…"), so every volume after the first arrives without its pictures, cover or front/back matter.
The box set EPUB carries no series metadata (no belongs-to-collection) and is titled "<book one> — The Complete Box Set".

gaps.title: Single-file Import reads title and author from Markdown frontmatter but not "series:"; only Bulk import keeps it.
No book-details field holds the series: the only inputs named for a series are the cover maker's "Series Line".
Bulk import places Markdown pictures but drops their captions ("![alt](file \"caption\")").
A series volume's EPUB does not name its series or its place in it (no belongs-to-collection / group-position), although the book carries meta.series.

gaps.title: Also-by pages are plain text in each volume: a series of N books needs N×(N−1) links typed and kept up to date by hand; nothing links one shelf book to another.

Story Insights and the Bible's mentions work on the open book only; who appears in which volume of a series could only be computed by opening each volume (the simulation did this to build the presence table).
Beta readers who share one internet address (a writing group, a library, a household) can leave only 10 comments per link per 10 minutes between them; the 11th gets 429.
The writer cannot answer a reader comment: the owner API offers resolve, unresolve and delete only (src/routes/shares.ts), and the comments panel has no reply control.
Every autosave sends the whole book, pictures included: the largest illustrated volume re-uploads its full JSON on each save.
Typing slows with the size of the whole book, not the chapter: each input event in the last chapter takes this long (the studio's own input handling, 10 events per step).
A book over the shelf's size limit (MANUSCRIPT_MAX_BYTES, 64 MiB of JSON) cannot be saved to the shelf; the studio says so and keeps it on the device.
The print PDF/X job did not finish for a book of this length (the saga-length volumes of ~40,000 words printed).

bugs.title: A volume added to a box set takes its title from the file name with hyphens and underscores turned into spaces, so "Tik-Tok of Oz" becomes "Tik Tok of Oz" in the box set (manuscriptFileToVolume); the title is not editable there.
Opening a book carries the PREVIOUS book's series onto it (applyBookDoc merges meta onto the old meta; the arriving book has no "series" key), and the next autosave writes it to the shelf.
Seen while seeding too: a standalone book opened after a series book arrived carrying that series.
